name: Specular Reflections via Polynomial Expansion
aliases: Specular Reflections via Polynomial Expansion — Fourier Projection-Slice Phong, Polynomial Phong Shading
definition: An extension to handle specular reflections by expanding the Phong specular term |N.H|^n into a polynomial using hemispherical illumination, allowing Fourier projection-slice evaluation.
summary: Specular Reflections via Polynomial Expansion analytically renders shiny surfaces in participating media by expanding the Phong term into a polynomial, avoiding ray tracing recursion.
